cross_market_insights: No result in any of the four markets answers the query as asked: none gives per-guest costs for a wedding abroad. AU results drift to domestic venue pages and calculators; London returns 2013 to 2014 US content.
Where a per-guest number appears (realweddings.com.au $150, pix.wedding A$384) it is a domestic Australian average, unsourced or derived from a national total.

Every market shows a 'What percent of guests come to a destination wedding?' PAA and forum threads on whether the couple pays guests' accommodation: the real reader questions are per-head cost and who pays.
Blocked domains (easyweddings.com.au) appear only in forum boxes; never link.

Opportunity: weak, dated SERP with an AI overview. A sourced, line-by-line pillar that quotes per-head prices from named venues by destination and splits couple-paid vs guest-paid lines has no competitor.
payload.recommended_angle: The only page that splits a destination wedding into per-head lines (catering, drinks, minimum spends, levies, transfers) and guest-paid lines (flights, rooms), quotes per-head prices exactly as our live destination cost pages state them, and shows what a Wedded Advisor does with each line.
